title: Track Refund (REFUND)
content: Absolutely! I completely understand your eagerness to stay informed about any updates regarding your restitution. Allow me to check the current status for you. While I retrieve the most recent information, may I kindly ask if you have received any communication from our team about the reimbursement? Your insights will provide us with a more comprehensive understanding of the situation. Thank you for your patience, and I'll ensure we address your query promptly.
